preconditions.description: The depth n of the initial complete binary tree is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and (line.strip() == '2' or (line.strip().split()[0] == '1' and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[1]) <= 4)) for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each query line is either '2' or '1 x' where x is an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(1 for line in stdin_lines[1:] if line.strip() == '2')
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 queries in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) % 1000000007 == int(line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Every output line contains a non-negative integer strictly less than 1000000007.

For each type 2 query, the output line corresponds to the total number of edges in the graph after applying all preceding type 1 operations, computed modulo 1000000007, where edge counts evolve based on the specific mirror operation (right, left, top, bottom) applied to the current graph structure.
